verdicts.claim: one genome grows the whole system, offline: organ 1’s origin genome (at most 2,048 bytes), on the reference device with its owner’s phrase, grows the organism and the system it lives in — a node of the shared foundation for each live organ (all four) and a keeper, the keys worked out from the phrase, a roster the founder signs, every node pinning every other from it — and growing it and asking it every held-out case touch the network 0 times (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, sockets, datagrams and name lookups trapped); no file it loads names a network module
verdicts.saw: a 496-byte genome (organ 1’s: true) grew organism c11de7054e9bb8ea and 5 nodes (keeper, shopper, triage, water, crop); the founder’s roster names 5; every node pins every other: true; network touched 0 times; 23 files loaded, network modules named: none

verdicts.claim: the system adds no error: the keeper asks every held-out case of every organ as a signed packet; every answer comes back and the keeper verifies each by running the organ again; each equals the organism’s own answer; the AUC of the answers that crossed, to six places, is each organ’s held-out AUC; and the keeper’s ledger credits every one
verdicts.saw: shopper: 4725 verified of 4725, 4725 the organism’s own answer, AUC 0.815265 (held 0.815265); triage: 720 verified of 720, 720 the organism’s own answer, AUC 0.952127 (held 0.952127); water: 720 verified of 720, 720 the organism’s own answer, AUC 0.747656 (held 0.747656); crop: 720 verified of 720, 720 the organism’s own answer, AUC 0.753796 (held 0.753796); the keeper’s ledger credits 6885 of 6885

verdicts.claim: it grows only what is verified: on the noisy-shop device the shop organ is cut and grows no node (keeper, triage, water, crop; a roster of 4; the keeper cannot ask the shop); on the no-water device the water organ is dormant and grows no node; a genome changed in one character grows nothing at all — no keys, no nodes
verdicts.saw: noisy shop: cut shopper, nodes keeper, triage, water, crop, asking the shop refused: no pinned peer holds skill shopper; no water: dormant water, nodes keeper, shopper, triage, crop, asking water refused: no pinned peer holds skill water; a changed genome: the genome was refused: signature, grew nothing

verdicts.claim: one door at every scale: every one-character change to the genome (every position) grows nothing; every one-character change to the signed roster is refused when it is read; every one-bit change to an ask is refused at the organ’s door, and every one-bit change to its answer at the keeper’s door; afterwards the genuine answer is verified and credited once; the same ask and the same answer sent again are refused
verdicts.saw: genome, 486 one-character changes: 10 not a genome, 467 signature, 9 not signed; roster, 4521: 654 not JSON, 24 not a fall-kit.roster.v1 roster, 71 the roster is not the founder’s, 5 a roster names 1–256 cards, 3764 the founder did not sign this roster, 3 a roster is signed; ask, 445 one-bit changes at the organ’s door: 445 refused; answer, 354 at the keeper’s door: 354 refused; then the genuine answer: verified (credited 1); replayed ask refused, replayed answer refused

verdicts.claim: the keeper cannot be lied to: a node holding the triage organ’s own key that answers in its place, every label flipped and every receipt sealed again so that it holds, is caught on 100 of 100 asks; a node holding the child’s shop key that answers honestly but from the parent organism (a stale organ) is caught on 100 of 100; neither is credited
verdicts.saw: the liar with the triage organ’s key: 100 failed of 100, credited 0; the stale organ with the child’s shop key: 100 failed of 100, credited 0
